criteria.description: Surfaces assumptions across all four product risks — Value, Usability, Feasibility, AND Viability — not just whether it can be built.
Writes assumptions as specific, falsifiable 'we assume that…' statements rather than vague risks.
Prioritizes assumptions by impact × evidence (or equivalent) to identify the riskiest leap-of-faith assumptions, rather than a flat list.
Pairs the riskiest assumptions with cheap tests (interview, fake-door, concierge, landing page, data analysis) to validate before building — not 'build the MVP'.
Gives real weight to Value and Viability risks (e.g. will users actually engage/share; does it fit the business) rather than over-indexing on feasibility.
Recommends an order to test assumptions (what to check first and why) rather than treating them equally.
